study.research_question: On the frozen 12-case synthetic matrix, does making exactly one target runtime skill available improve native deterministic verifier outcomes under the same GEODE runtime and gpt-5.6-sol subscription policy?
study.research_gap: The offline contract and concrete runner are validated. The first frozen execution was infrastructure-invalid before generation because the provider rejected an unsupported response-schema keyword; GEODE has no score-bearing paired observation after the source-schema correction.
study.hypothesis: The sum of matched with-skill minus without-skill native verifier passes across 12 cases is positive.

primary_metric.name: mean signed native-verifier pass delta
primary_metric.aggregation: For each matched case compute int(with-skill verifier pass) minus int(without-skill verifier pass), sum the 12 signed values, and divide by 12.

study.decision_rule: Support the preregistered hypothesis only if every arm is valid and the signed verifier-pass numerator is greater than zero; otherwise report not-supported without runtime promotion authority.
study.invalidation_rule: If any arm fails to return a successful runtime termination, exact frozen request identity, fixture-bound verifier receipt, trajectory, or reward within 180 seconds, mark the aggregate not measurable. Do not retry or replace a semantic verifier failure; an infrastructure retry requires a separately frozen run ID and fresh output root.
study.analysis_plan: Execute all 24 arms serially in the frozen alternating order. Preserve every arm. Report the exact primary numerator and denominator plus per-pair verifier, skill activation, irrelevant-action, token, elapsed-time, and safety deltas. Inspect target-skill and prompt-class rows descriptively without changing the preregistered primary rule or making population-level claims.

environment.reset_strategy: Launch every arm in a new child process with a unique fresh GEODE_STATE_ROOT and session ID; do not resume an output root.

execution.command_redacted: uv run python -m evals.benchmarks.skill_attribution_live run --run-spec run-spec.json --fixture evals/benchmarks/fixtures/skill-attribution-pilot.json --output-dir fresh-run-output

comparison.comparator: same GEODE runtime, model, route, tools, prompt, fixture, and initial-state contract without the target skill in the runtime registry

privacy.redaction_boundary: The synthetic fixture and digest-only trajectories may be reviewed for publication. Keep provider reasoning, system/session text, child stdout/stderr, GEODE_STATE_ROOT databases, OAuth material, environment dumps, machine-local absolute paths, and operator identity private.
